items.title: Spy Teens
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Masters of disguise! Pros at jumping, diving, hiding, climbing! Sneak and spy with friends. Become you best, secret agent self with these 11 skins.

items.title: Neon Fashion
items.creator: House of How
items.description: The 10 brightest teens got together to show off their neon style in this pack. Colorful, edgy, cute, and cool. Show it all off with this skin pack!

items.title: Ninja Mobs
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These 10 ninja mob skins are sticking it to the man with their karate chops and "hi-yah's"! Out of sight, wins the fight. These sneaky, sly and agile skins are bound to add a whole new level of fun and adventure to your game play!

items.title: Pastel Cuties
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
If you love pastel colors, cuteness and teen style then Pastel Cuties is perfect for you! These 16 skins come in two options, regular and chibi for those who love to look kawaii! Match with your friends or be the cutest of the crowd with these adorable designs.

- Includes demons, axolotl hat, frog hat and ghoul horns!
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Lucky Block Fury
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Hey you, are you ready to smash the lucky blocks!? We've prepared a battle ax and a stick for you, grab your tools now and show your rage against the lucky blocks! Let's de-stress now and see how lucky you are at the same time!

+ More than 500 possible outcomes
+ Fully furnished castle and town
+ 2 different weapons

items.title: Suits Up!
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
It's time for your date! You have to put on your most stylish skin, you really are dressing to impress! Don't worry though, 16 stylish skins are waiting for you in this pack! Enjoy the unique skins in the Suits Up pack now!

+ 16 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Couple Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you want to have a wonderful couple skin with your love? If so, check out this skin pack now! Choose your favorite matching skins and dazzle everyone with your harmony!

+ 12 couple themed skins
+ 2 free skins
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Cat Masks
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description: Wear these fabulous cat masks!

items.title: True Fashion
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Find your new favorite skin to show off to all of your friends!

+ 6 teen skins
+ A mix of unique and stylish outfits.

items.title: Autumn Aesthetic
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Autumn has begun! Get some fashionable shoes and a trendy jacket and show everyone your style! Spend time with your friends, whether it’s at school or chilling at home! 

- 8 unique skins for roleplaying
- Perfect for kids and teens
- Licensed by Xenon Design and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Cosy Autumn Hoodies
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The autumn season is here once again, so we must stay warm with these cosy hoodies! This fall collection brings 8 awesome outfits for you to be stylish in! Pick your favorite and show off to your buddies!

- 8 AWESOME autumn hoodies
- Licensed by UniDesigns and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Survival+ Dragons
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Survive in an expansion of vanilla Minecraft when Dragons come to the overworld. Craft new weapons to fight never-seen-before bosses and their minions. Explore the Molten biome, unlock the vault and travel into a new dimension to fight the Molten Dragon!

+ 14 Dragons
+ Survival expansion
+ New ores and mobs

items.title: Friendly Mobs
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Ever imagine a world where all the mobs were friendly and lived together in harmony? This skin pack puts a twist on the average mob and transforms them into cute, lovable characters!
-20 skins
-HD

items.title: Friendly Demons
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Ever thought of becoming friends with demons or dragons?
They wear no masks and this time they are friendlier than ever!
So grab your favorite skin and wonder around your worlds the friendly way.

+ 8 epic skins!

items.title: Dog World
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Are you a dog person? This pack offers a wide variety of furry friends to choose from. Which dog is your favorite?

items.title: Thor
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Thor is a Viking and Norse god. He wields a super cool hammer named Mjolnir, which strikes lightning at his enemies! Play as thor, defend Asgard, fight the ice giants, and use your hammer to summon lighting at your enemies!

+ Thor
+ Custom armor
+ Custom weapon
+ Lightning hammer

items.title: Planet Teens
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Explore every planet in the galaxy with friends.... don't they look a bit strange to you?

- 8 outer space skins!
- Free skin: Star
- Colorful, fashionable & dreamy!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Transylvania Trains
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Travel across Transylvania with terrifying trains! Defeat the Pumpkin King and other monsters to unlock crafting recipes for more trains. Explore vast castles, caves, and custom biomes.
- 7 Halloween themed trains
- 11 monsters and bosses to fight
- Quests at each of the 7 stations
- Survival, roleplay, or multiplayer fun

Pardon me, boy. Is this the Transylvania station?

items.title: Candy Lucky Skyblock
items.creator: A30x1
items.description:
On this skyworld you willl find candy islands and try your luck at the same time!

+ Lucky blocks!
+ Giant candy around the map!

items.title: Giant Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Test your luck with Giant Lucky Blocks! Open a giant lucky block to receive treasure! But be aware, some might set you back instead of helping you...

+ 150+ possible drops!
+ 20+ possible structure outcomes!
+ 2 matching skins!

items.title: PrestonPlayz Matrix Hackers
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
There’s been a glitch in Preston’s matrix and hackers have arrived! Beware, this pack is full of errors and bugs! Choose your skin wisely...

- 1 free Preston skin
- 16 total skins

By PrestonPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: Trendy Teens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
The coolest teens arrived in style! Dress up as a fashion model and enchant wherever you go.

+ 12 very stylish skins
+ 2 free skins

items.title: Cat World
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Are you a cat person? This pack offers a wide variety of furry friends to choose from. Which cat is your favorite?

items.title: Skyblock
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Skyblock in 1.19! Skyblock is a survival challenge map!
+ Warden in skyblock!
